comment: Asset-swap manifest. Convert David's STLs with tools/stl_to_glb.py, drop the .glb files next to index.html (flat folder, no subfolders), then set 'file' below. Parts left null use the procedural placeholder. Origins: pelvis and thigh at the hip axle, shank and foot at the knee. Legs hang along -Y, walking direction is +X, units are metres.

fullModel.comment: Used by the 'View in your space' viewer (Scene Viewer / Quick Look). Replace with the converted full XTI assembly when available.
